response.justification: Bogdan meets the 15-year experience minimum with 20+ years in software engineering and is currently engaged with AI agent infrastructure at re:cinq. However, the role prioritizes Principal-level AI strategy expertise and demonstrated AI-powered products—areas notably absent from his background. While his technical foundation is strong, he lacks formal AI/ML education, proven AI product innovations, and evidence of director-level strategic advisory or customer consulting experience that the position requires.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience across diverse platforms and infrastructure scales, well exceeding the 15-year requirement
Currently hands-on with AI agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing engagement with emerging AI technologies and frameworks
Proven ability to architect and optimize high-performance systems handling millions of requests/second (Dunnhumby) with strong cloud and Kubernetes expertise
concerns: No Master's degree or PhD in AI/ML; background is primarily full-stack software development without specialized AI/ML education or deep domain expertise
Resume demonstrates no AI products, platforms, or recognized expertise in AI—the job explicitly requires 'recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms'
No evidence of strategic leadership, director-level experience, or customer advisory roles; position requires advising strategic customers and identifying future cloud/AI product directions
